summary: Inspected 25+ files across the FastMultiplication library, focusing on the 13 candidate infrastructure/test/executable/template files analogous to those excluded in the prior review (RRV-bdd0a1acb57b-r8). The prior review excluded Tests.lean, PolicyCheck.lean, and PolicyMain.lean as pure infrastructure with no original mathematical declarations or proofs. This review finds the same pattern across the expanded Submission/ and Emit/ directories: executable entry points (Main.lean, PolicyMain.lean), acceptance-check roots (Check.lean, PolicyCheck.lean), the CI axiom guard (Audit.lean), certificate aliases (Correct.lean, Score.lean), submitter templates (Template.lean, PolicyTemplate.lean), worked examples on shipped templates (PolicyTests.lean), and the large acceptance-test suite (Emit/Tests.lean). All contain only native_decide examples, #assert_axioms commands, JSON printing logic, trivial aliases of generic theorems, or template boilerplate — no original definitions, computational functions with termination proofs, or kernel-checked proofs of mathematical substance. The lakefile.lean build script is also pure configuration. The remaining 89 files (core framework, implementation, model, emit/reflect internals, table generation, gate-count proofs, QFT/shor/phase-product correctness) all contain substantial formal mathematics and stay searchable.
